name: localpresence-outbound-os
description: Halloway Associates Outbound OS — autonomous B2B outreach for SMB digital presence

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run worker -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && node scripts/wait-for-db.mjs && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
